title: Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases: Resolution and Closing of a Case
content:
**Rule.** A Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case is resolved only in one of two ways, following the plan's resolution evidence:

- a payoff case on the loan has reached satisfied status; or
- foreclosure counsel reports the foreclosure sale completed.

The payoff case's status is read from Cedarline's payoff record, matched by its own reference.

**Resolution type.** The resolution type follows the plan of the satisfied payoff case:

| Satisfied payoff case plan | Resolution type recorded |
|---|---|
| Borrower Voluntary Payoff | paid in full |
| HECM-to-HECM Refinance Payoff | paid in full |
| Heir Retention Payoff | paid in full |
| Estate Market Sale Payoff | sale |
| Approved Short Sale Payoff | short sale |
| Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure | deed in lieu |
| (completed foreclosure sale) | foreclosure sale |

The resolution type is always one of the plan's resolution types.

**Closed date.** The closed date is the payoff case's satisfaction date, or the foreclosure sale date.

## Points of judgement

- A payoff case that is open but not yet satisfied does not resolve the case.
- A payoff case satisfied under the Estate Market Sale Payoff plan on an invented 9 November closes the maturity case on 9 November with resolution type sale.
